```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

data <- read.csv("IsogenicFC_byTimePoint_20241016.csv")

# Keep only rows with log2FC values
data_clean <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(FoldChange_het_WT))
```

```{r}
#adjust to add 2,4, and 6 month columns 
data_wide <- data_clean %>%
  select(Protein, geneSym, TimePoint, FoldChange_het_WT) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = TimePoint,
              values_from = FoldChange_het_WT)


```

```{r}
#scatter plot of 4 and 6 months
fc_cutoff <- log2(1.5)

ggplot(data_wide, aes(x = Month_4, y = Month_6)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  
  # 1.5 FC threshold lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "4 vs 6 Month log2 Fold Change",
       x = "Month 4 log2FC",
       y = "Month 6 log2FC")
```

```{r}
#Scatter plot
ggplot(data_wide, aes(x = Month_4, y = Month_6)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  stat_density_2d(color = "blue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Concordance Correlation Coefficient function (no external packages)
ccc_base <- function(x, y, boot = FALSE, nboot = 2000, seed = 123) {
  # remove NA pairs
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  n <- length(x)
  if(n < 2) return(NA)

  mu_x <- mean(x); mu_y <- mean(y)
  s2_x <- var(x); s2_y <- var(y)
  cov_xy <- cov(x, y)
  # CCC formula: 2*cov / (var_x + var_y + (mean_x - mean_y)^2)
  ccc_val <- 2 * cov_xy / (s2_x + s2_y + (mu_x - mu_y)^2)

  res <- list(ccc = ccc_val, n = n)

  if (boot) {
    set.seed(seed)
    bres <- replicate(nboot, {
      idx <- sample(seq_len(n), replace = TRUE)
      xs <- x[idx]; ys <- y[idx]
      mu_xs <- mean(xs); mu_ys <- mean(ys)
      s2_xs <- var(xs); s2_ys <- var(ys)
      cov_xys <- cov(xs, ys)
      2 * cov_xys / (s2_xs + s2_ys + (mu_xs - mu_ys)^2)
    })
    ci <- quantile(bres, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
    res$boot <- bres
    res$ci <- ci
  }
  return(res)
}
```

```{r}
x <- data_wide$Month_4
y <- data_wide$Month_6

ccc_res <- ccc_base(x, y, boot = TRUE, nboot = 1000)  # bootstrap optional
ccc_res$ccc
ccc_res$ci
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# compute stats
x <- data_wide$Month_4
y <- data_wide$Month_6

pearson_test <- cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
pearson_r <- pearson_test$estimate
pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value

lm_mod <- lm(y ~ x)
rsq <- summary(lm_mod)$r.squared

ccc_res <- ccc_base(x, y, boot = FALSE)
ccc_val <- ccc_res$ccc

# build annotation text
anno_text <- paste0("Pearson r = ", round(pearson_r, 2),
                    " (p = ", signif(pearson_p, 2), ")\n",
                    "R² = ", round(rsq, 2), "\n",
                    "CCC = ", round(ccc_val, 2),
                    "\nn = ", ccc_res$n)

# plot
fc_cutoff <- log2(1.5)
p1<- ggplot(data_wide, aes(x = Month_4, y = Month_6)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.8, color = "black") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_equal() +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(data_wide$Month_4, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = max(data_wide$Month_6, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = anno_text, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Month 4 log2FC", y = "Month 6 log2FC",
       title = "4 vs 6 month log2 Fold Change — correlation & concordance")

ggsave("correl_4_6m_plot.pdf",
       plot = p1,
       width = 10,
       height = 8,
       dpi = 300)
```
